tickets.title: Review missing signature follow-up requirements
tickets.text:
Review the incomplete document package using these criteria:

Required review criteria:
- Identify the specific form, page, and signature block that is incomplete.
- Confirm whose signature or initials are missing and whether a date is also required.
- Verify whether the signature must be wet ink, electronic, notarized, medallion guaranteed, witnessed, or accompanied by spouse consent.
- Check whether any related fields were left blank because of the missing signature.
- Confirm the document version is still current and acceptable for submission.

Evidence to collect:
- Copy of the rejection notice or custodian comment.
- Marked copy of the form showing the missing signature location.
- Confirmation of signer authority, if signing for an entity, trust, estate, or under power of attorney.
- Secure delivery record for the corrected signature request.
- Final accepted copy or confirmation number after resubmission.

tickets.title: Complete beneficiary update checklist
tickets.text:
Use this checklist before submitting or recording beneficiary updates:

- Confirm the account registration and account type requiring a beneficiary review.
- Verify current primary and contingent beneficiaries on file.
- Confirm full legal names, relationships, dates of birth if required, and allocation percentages.
- Check that total primary percentages equal 100% and total contingent percentages equal 100% when applicable.
- Identify whether spouse consent, trust documentation, or plan administrator approval is required.
- Confirm whether IRA, retirement plan, transfer-on-death, insurance, or annuity rules apply.
- Send the correct custodian or carrier form through the approved secure process.
- Save confirmation of submission and final acceptance in the client record.
- Note any estate planning follow-up needed with the client’s attorney.
